title: LigandMPNN Input Parameters
description: Normalized request shape for the LigandMPNN sequence-design adapter. LigandMPNN extends ProteinMPNN with explicit small-molecule context for active-site design; backbones come in alongside either per-atom ligand coordinates or an SDF reference resolved into /inputs/ligands/.

backbones.description: List of backbone structures to design sequences for. Typically S3 URIs resolved into /inputs/backbones/*.pdb at runtime.

seeds.description: Random seeds for sampling; one run per seed, producing num_seq_per_target sequences each.

ligand_atoms.description: Per-atom ligand coordinates. Mutually exclusive with ligand_sdf. Each atom is identified by its parent residueId (chain + resi, e.g. 'A1') and atomName as seen in the input PDB.

ligand_sdf.description: S3 URI of an SDF/MOL file describing the ligand. Resolved into /inputs/ligands/ligand.sdf at runtime. Mutually exclusive with ligand_atoms.

omit_aas.description: Single-letter amino acids to exclude from designed sequences. 'X' is always recommended; 'C' removes cysteines.

num_seq_per_target.description: Number of sequences to sample per backbone per seed.

ligand_context_radius.description: Angstrom cutoff around ligand atoms for 'in-context' residues; residues beyond this radius are sampled without ligand conditioning.

fixed_positions.description: Optional per-chain fixed residue indices (1-based). Keys are chain IDs; values are lists of residue indices whose identity should NOT be redesigned.
